verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an official Gemini desktop app for Mac with an OS-level keyboard shortcut (Option+Space) to summon it without opening a browser, satisfying the 'app + shortcuts' portion. However, 'access to what is on your screen' is only documented for the Android mobile app ('Hey Google' for on-screen help), with no evidence of a desktop screen-reading/screenshare capability. Missing for 10: desktop-specific screen-context access, Windows app parity, independent/hands-on confirmation of shortcut or screen features.
